claim: Patchline ships a causal-forest heterogeneity analysis identifying which teams benefit most from gating. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the causal forest claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make causal-forest-heterogeneity-gate`.
